meta.name: alfworld-open-receptacle
meta.description: This skill opens a closed receptacle to access its contents. It should be triggered when an agent needs to interact with items inside a closed container (e.g., fridge, microwave, drawer). The skill takes a receptacle identifier as input, performs the open action, and outputs the observation of the interior, enabling subsequent item retrieval or placement.

copy.tagline: 打开封闭容器以获取内部物品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模拟环境中打开冰箱、抽屉等容器拿东西
copy.tagline_en: Open closed receptacles to access their contents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to open containers like fridges or drawers in a simulated environment

howto.what: 装好这个技能后,当 Claude 需要打开一个关闭的容器(如冰箱、微波炉、抽屉)时,它会自动执行打开操作,并返回容器内部的物品列表。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 从关闭的容器中取物或放入物品,或观察到容器处于关闭状态时触发。

say.note: Claude会打开指定冰箱并告知内部物品。
Claude会打开微波炉并显示里面有什么。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, when Claude needs to open a closed container (e.g., fridge, microwave, drawer), it will automatically perform the open action and return the list of items inside.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to retrieve or place items from/into a closed container, or when the container is observed as closed.

say_en.note: Claude opens the fridge and shows its contents.
Claude opens the microwave and reveals what is inside.
